naske19.title: How do we disagree without a fight?
naske19.caption: Disagreeing with someone you love doesn't mean you're drifting apart. Start where you agree, swap "you're wrong" for "I see it differently", and keep holding hands while you work it out.

naske20.title: They got me a gift I really don't like.
naske20.caption: When a gift misses, the thought behind it still landed. Say thank you and mean it. If they ask later, a gentle, honest answer is a kindness too.

naske21.title: It's too cold to go on dates.
naske21.caption: Winter doesn't have to put dating on pause. A market stroll, a sunrise walk with cocoa or a cozy night mapping trips you'd love to take all count. Bundle up and say yes.

naske22.title: When do we talk about the future?
naske22.caption: Wondering when to bring up the future? Not on date one, and not never. Give it a few months, then ask what they want on a calm night, not across a busy holiday table.

naske23.title: Their friends don't get me.
naske23.caption: Feeling like the outsider with your partner's friends is hard. You don't have to win the whole room. Find one person, ask about the thing they love, and let your partner help bridge the rest.

naske24.title: How do I comfort someone who's sad?
naske24.caption: You don't need perfect words to comfort someone who's hurting. Sit close, ask if they want a hug or some quiet, then bring a blanket and their favorite snack. Save this for someone you love.

naske25.title: They said 'I love you' and I froze.
naske25.caption: If "I love you" caught you off guard, freezing is allowed. Answer with the truth instead of a reflex: "I really like you, and I need a bit more time." Honest is the kind reply.

naske26.title: How do I make a night in feel special?
naske26.caption: A night in feels special through small choices: one candle, one dish cooked together, phones in a basket by the door and a few good questions to talk through slowly.

naske27.title: We text all day but say nothing.
naske27.caption: Texting all day can still leave you feeling far apart. Swap one message for a real call and ask what's been on their mind. Small talk is only the door; walk through it together.

naske28.title: I'm spending the holidays alone.
naske28.caption: Spending the holidays on your own can still feel warm with a little planning. Cook your favorite, call someone you love, and if an invitation comes, it's okay to say yes.
